name: siso-workstation
description: Private local MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT control terminal, filesystem, and process operations on this Mac.

interface.shortDescription: Execute shell, filesystem, and process tasks on this Mac from ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Private plugin that bridges ChatGPT to a local SISO Workstation MCP server for local shell execution, file read/write/edit, search, and process management.
